title: Labeled eval fixture
description: One labeled example for one classifier/decision. Fixtures are the ONLY sanctioned response to a new incident or edge case under the prose-rule moratorium (see ../README.md): append a labeled example here, never a new rule or conjunct to BUS_PROTOCOL.md or the agent files.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. Convention: <decision>-NNN. Never reused, never renumbered — example packs and promotion records cite it.

decision.description: Which classifier / choke-point decision this example trains. One ladder per decision; a fixture belongs to exactly one.

input.description: The evidence bundle as the classifier would actually see it at decision time. MUST NOT contain the answer, the verdict, or any hindsight the classifier would not have. If a field would not be available at the moment of the call, it does not belong here.

presented.description: The primary text put in front of the classifier — for premise_screener, the backlog row text verbatim (the task TEXT is the identity; file.md:LINE is only a hint).

asserted_state.description: The state of the world the input asserts or presupposes — the premise whose truth is being screened.

source_hint.description: Non-authoritative locator (file:line, handoff id). Advisory only; the text is the identity.

context.description: Any additional bundle content available at decision time.

label.description: Ground-truth verdict for this decision's forced-choice ladder. For premise_screener: still-needed | stale | UNKNOWN.

label_provenance.description: WHERE THE LABEL CAME FROM. Mandatory. Only 'primary-artifact' and 'operator' labels may gate a classifier promotion; 'ledger-narrative' fixtures are advisory/few-shot only, because the project's own audit found the ledger graded itself and is the least trustworthy possible source.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the artifact that PROVES the label: repo-relative path, optionally :LINE or :LINE-LINE, and/or a commit SHA. For label_provenance 'operator', the operator record (message id, ratification artifact). Never a restatement of the label.

created.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or timestamp the fixture was labeled.

notes.description: What makes this example discriminative — the feature a classifier must learn from it. For ledger-narrative fixtures, MUST state why no primary artifact was reachable.

promotion_gating.description: Whether this fixture may gate a classifier promotion. DEFAULTS TO TRUE when absent — opting out is explicit and fails closed. A promotion-gating fixture MUST NOT have label_provenance 'ledger-narrative', so every ledger-narrative fixture must carry "promotion_gating": false; validate_fixtures.py fails otherwise. Defaulting ledger-narrative to non-gating was rejected: it would make the gate vacuous, firing only on fixtures whose author had already set the flag.

tags.description: Optional free-form grouping (incident class, failure mode).
